sources.entry: Mockplus - Prototype faster, smarter and easier.

summary.name: Mockplus
summary.one_liner: Mockplus is an all-in-one product design platform for sketching, wireframing, interactive prototyping, design systems and developer handoff.
use_cases: Creating wireframes and interactive prototypes without code
Importing Axure or Adobe XD files to keep editing
Sharing prototypes by link and collecting on-screen feedback
Handing off designs with specs and CSS snippets to developers
Building shared design systems and asset libraries
Drawing user flowcharts and annotated specs
summary.what_it_does: Mockplus provides drag-and-drop UI/UX widget libraries, icons, component libraries and templates for iOS, macOS, Android, Web and Material Design. It supports adding interactions, animations, mobile gestures and custom states to prototypes without writing code. Teams can co-edit projects in real time, share a prototype via a single link, and collect on-screen comments. Designers can attach notes to components or pages and build flowcharts, and publish prototypes to generate automated redlines, design specs and CSS snippets for developers. The page also mentions importing Axure and Adobe XD files and an enterprise version with end-to-end encryption.
notable: Imports Axure and Adobe XD files for editing and co-editing
Offline version, Mockplus 3 Offline, announced on the page
Automated redlines, specs and CSS snippets for developer handoff
caveats: Enterprise version with full data control requires a request for a demo; pricing not stated on the page
Page does not give detailed pricing tiers; 'Get Started for Free' suggests a free entry point
